mmq_prefill.reporting_boundary: per-shape rankings only; no composite score

mmvq_decode.reporting_boundary: per-shape rankings only; no composite score

rocmfp4-ue4m4-fast.category: standalone Codebook10 plus conventional unsigned UE4M4 scale, one scale per 32-weight block

identity_boundary: rocmfp4-ue4m4-fast stores Codebook10 values with one conventional unsigned UE4M4 scale byte per 32 weights

method.aggregation: median within each five-sample round, then median across 12 round medians; p95 is across round medians
method.paired_bootstrap: 20,000 deterministic paired-round resamples with replacement; comparison-specific SHA-256-derived seed; sorted indices 500 and 19500 for the reported 95% interval
method.paired_speedup: per-round (control_ms / ue4m4_ms - 1) * 100, then median across 12 paired rounds
method.schedule: first 10 measured rounds form five reverse pairs; final two seeded Latin shifts balance the odd five-candidate roster to 2-3 visits per position

quality_boundary: Flat32 and K256 quality rows come from different sampled populations. Q4_K is an ecosystem control and must not be described as a paired flat32 quality proof.
scope: standalone exact-shape native gfx1151 MMVQ/MMQ mechanism evidence; not GGML/GGUF integration, model, server, or deployment evidence
